cases.name: closures_and_scopes
cases.code:
def counter():
    n = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return inc
c1, c2 = counter(), counter()
print(c1(), c1(), c2())
total = 0
def add(x):
    global total
    total += x
add(5); add(7); print(total)
fs = [lambda: i for i in range(3)]
print([f() for f in fs])
fs = [lambda i=i: i for i in range(3)]
print([f() for f in fs])
def outer():
    x = "outer"
    def inner(): return x
    x = "changed"
    return inner()
print(outer())
